main_text.l: SECT. XXII. De Mediorum reconciliationis impossibilitate.

IAm vero cum nemo sanus illud de nobis suspicari vnquam possit, fore, eò vt iniquitatis diueniamus aliquando, vt relictis Dei signis ad Antichristi illius Romani castra perfide transfugiamus; Ecqua spes est, posse demum Pontificios ad sanam mentem primæuæ antiquitatis reuocari? O si indulgeret illud Deus orbi Christiano! si liceret nos tantæ felicitatis vel omine solo consolari? Quàm iucundum foret illud,

page.notes: Drop cap "I" with "Am" rendered as printed; the printed line reads "eò vtiinsaniæ" which is transcribed as printed in the scan ("eò vtiinsaniæ diueniamus"); the word "iniquitatis" above is a reading correction and should be checked against "insaniæ" as printed. Faint show-through text in the right margin is omitted. Black-letter-free page; no marginal notes printed.
